draft.defaultToFill: Verify the captured facts, move them to the target, delete this draft.

guidance: Save to the vault the work belongs to. Never link, copy or share notes between vaults.
Record only facts already in your context (user messages, specs, session findings). No new research.
New information goes to a draft. Never merge it into verified notes.
A claim is code-read unless tagged (inferred) or (runtime-verified).
Tag every assumption (assumption) inline or list it under Assumptions.
New known issues and open questions: propose them to the user, never write them without a yes.
Be short: bullets, no padding, no repeated context. One fact, one place.
Note names are unique per vault: kebab-case, prefixed with the project key.
Refer to notes as [[note]] links, never as file paths (no .md). Targets are [[note]] or a folder.
Nothing new worth keeping: save nothing.
